stable_attempt_identity_before_dispatch.evidence: Controller derives attemptId from experiment identity plus attempt ordinal and passes it into the frozen evaluator boundary.

durable_prepare_before_spawn.evidence: runEvaluator persists immutable spawn intent before artifact capability minting and before subprocess.spawn; test asserts failed intent persistence prevents spawn.

immutable_evaluator_and_candidate_identi.evidence: Policy/evaluator provenance hashes, immutable experiment lineage, candidate commit and exact worktree verification bind the evaluated object and evaluator configuration.

provider_dispatch_observation.evidence: After spawn returns, providerPid and spawnedAt are durably recorded.

durable_outcome_lineage.evidence: recordAttemptOutcome atomically stores exit/quiescence facts, immutable measured/failed result JSON, evaluator artifacts and transition evidence in SQLite.

ambiguous_attempt_recovery.evidence: Recovery refuses to rerun an attempt whose whole-process-tree quiescence is not durably proven; it records attempt-uncertain and retains the lock.

quiescent_missing_outcome_recovery.evidence: If an attempt is proven quiescent but lacks a durable outcome and artifacts, recovery starts the same experiment again under the next attempt ordinal. Integration test demonstrates two such attempts and eventual recovery-rerun exhaustion.

candidate_decision_and_git_reconciliatio.evidence: Metric is durably checkpointed before decision reconciliation; accepted/rejected experiment state and candidate/accepted Git refs are reconciled to immutable commits.

real_process_tree_kill.evidence: Evaluator integration test uses descendants that ignore SIGTERM and escalates to SIGKILL before persisting quiescent timeout/cancel outcome.

real_controller_process_kill_matrix.scope: The restart integration suite uses injected exceptions, controller disposal/cancellation, and real evaluator process-tree termination; no source-bound test was found that SIGKILLs the controller process after each prepare/spawn/observed/outcome boundary.

provider_side_idempotency_or_receipt_rec.scope: The audited evaluator is a local subprocess. Ambiguous attempts fail closed rather than consulting an independent provider ledger/idempotency receipt as Agent libOS does for external effects.

logical_evaluation_exactly_once.evidence: A proven-quiescent attempt whose durable outcome is missing may be rerun under a new attempt ID. This is safe from concurrent duplicate execution but can consume the same logical evaluation surface more than once.

evaluation_query_or_statistical_budget_a.scope: Attempts are counted durably, but no candidate-local anytime-valid evidence state, holdout-query budget, alpha/e-value state, or cross-candidate statistical spending contract was found.

selection_unused_outer_test.scope: The system exposes one configured evaluator in the adaptive loop; a separate untouched outer-test channel is not a first-class part of the audited controller contract.

key_distinction: dsh-autoresearch materially closes the pre-dispatch identity and durable evaluation-attempt lineage gap, but attempt-level crash safety is not yet logical-query exactly-once safety. If a quiescent attempt loses its outcome, a new physical evaluation may be issued. For scarce/adaptive held-out evaluation, consumption must therefore be charged to a stable logical query identity above attemptId and survive reruns.

minimal_extension.logical_evaluation_id: H(protocol_version, incumbent_commit, candidate_commit, evaluator_provenance, evaluation_snapshot, instance_or_batch, seed_or_replication)
required_state: logical evaluation prepared and query/statistical budget reserved before attempt 1
all physical attempt IDs linked to the same logical evaluation ID
consumption marked monotonically once any attempt may have reached the evaluator
provider receipt/idempotency reconciliation for remote evaluators, or explicit fail-closed unknown state
feedback-release transition distinct from outcome persistence
candidate-local statistical update from settled logical evaluations only
proposal-crossing statistical spend committed before promotion
outer-test ledger with zero adaptive-consumption transitions
minimal_extension.falsification: Run matched uninterrupted vs real-controller-SIGKILL executions after durable prepare, immediately after OS spawn, after provider observation, after quiescence, after outcome, after feedback, after statistical spend and after promotion. Require identical logical query-consumption count, physical dispatch accounting, feedback, statistical state, lineage and outer-test non-consumption.

scope_guard: This contract is an implementation audit of the cited public revision. It does not claim that dsh-autoresearch statistically validates repeated self-improvement, provides an untouched outer test, or improves task performance because of these durability mechanisms.
exact_next_action: Search for a self-improving agent that adds a stable logical evaluation/query ID and durable query/statistical consumption above physical evaluator attempts, preferably with an independent provider receipt/idempotency ledger and real controller SIGKILL injection. If absent, use dsh-autoresearch as the concrete minimal seam: add a logical_evaluations table above attempts, monotone consumption/spend states and crash tests, then compare uninterrupted versus kill-resume runs. Continue separately searching for candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, cross-candidate durable spending, bounded feedback and a selection-unused outer test.
